story.originalTitle: What does Max Verstappen's new contract say about Red Bull and his F1 future? Our writers have their say
story.summaryEn: Max Verstappen has confirmed a new contract with Red Bull that will keep him at the team for three more Formula 1 seasons until 2030, ending rumours of a switch to Mercedes or McLaren.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘）的新合同对红牛和他的一级方程式未来意味着什么？我们的作者们发表了自己的看法。
这是对劳伦特·梅基斯（Laurent Mekies）的信任投票，还是他唯一真正的选择？我们的作者们对这位荷兰车手续约一纸F1合同发表了他们的评判。
马克斯·维斯塔潘（维斯塔潘），红牛车队，劳伦特·梅基斯（Laurent Mekies），红牛车队领队
关于他惊人转投梅赛德斯或迈凯伦的疯狂传闻于今晨烟消云散，马克斯·维斯塔潘确认签署新合同，将继续留在红牛车队再战三个一级方程式赛季。
这位荷兰车手宣布与红牛签订一份持续到F1当前时代结束的2030年的新合同，从而终结了关于他对车队的信任以及对F1的热爱的一切猜测……至少目前是这样。
但这份新合同对维斯塔潘、红牛和一级方程式意味着什么？我们的撰稿人分享了对这次签约的看法。
去年，新上任的车队领队洛朗·梅基斯接手了红牛的一个艰难局面，要对抗一个正在崩塌的帝国的叙事——关键人物正在陆续逃离，包括设计传奇阿德里安·纽维、体育总监乔纳森·惠特利和策略主管威尔·科特尼。
红牛在2025年末的翻身，当时维斯塔潘极其接近从迈凯伦车手手中抢走世界冠军，缓解了一些这样的担忧。但维斯塔潘的亲密盟友詹皮耶罗·兰比亚斯签下合同将于2028年前转投迈凯伦，这几乎没有打消这样的看法：即便红牛这艘船还不算正在下沉，至少也已经进了大量的水。
2026赛季的开局也不太顺利，红牛在赛车研发上落后，目前在车队积分榜上排名第四，同时在F1的政治动力单元博弈中被对手占了上风。
但将车队的四届世界冠军再锁定两年，是梅基斯的一大筹码。让这位荷兰车手留在车队，对红牛的长期雄心至关重要，也表明人们对梅基斯演进车队技术体系的计划抱有一定信心。
维斯塔潘留下的消息并不令人意外，但两年的续约在一定程度上出乎意料。新合同的细节尚未披露，但最合理的结果是，维斯塔潘将因延长效力而获得丰厚报酬，而红牛很可能会通过比以往安排更有利于车队的性能条款换来这份承诺——此前的安排曾让维斯塔潘的去留每年夏天都变成一场闹剧。
证明迈凯伦传闻只是谈判筹码
F1圈内的“评论家们”整个夏天都在社交媒体上争先恐后地声称掌握维斯塔潘即将转会迈凯伦的独家内幕消息。但对于真正了解情况的人来说，这显然是一场精心策划的虚张声势。
原因在于，乔治·拉塞尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿已经满足了现有“2+1”合同中的表现条款，使梅赛德斯和法拉利能够触发“+1”部分，将合同延续至2027年底。由于这只是现有合同的执行机制，而不是新合同或附加延期，因此没有任何公开公告就顺利完成了。
鉴于夏尔·勒克莱尔和基米·安东内利的位置也已稳固，这堵死了维斯塔潘最有可能的转会去向。那么，他的经纪团队能做些什么来从红牛那里争取到最有利的条件呢？
自2024年初红牛从之前的主导地位骤然下滑以来，维斯塔潘及其管理层一直奉行“欲擒故纵”的策略，经常通过荷兰媒体上的“御用写手”放风，称维斯塔潘的合同中含有对他非常有利的表现条款，可以让他提前离队。
但离开还需要一个说得过去的目的地。通往梅赛德斯和法拉利的路都被堵死了，迈凯伦便不得不充当谈判筹码——于是有关这位荷兰车手与皮亚斯特里互换座位的传闻就被凭空炮制了出来。
起初，迈凯伦摆出一副暗自觉得好笑、默许纵容的姿态，因为上个赛季车队与Piastri的经纪团队关系变得紧张，所以放任这些传闻发酵，正好可以借此把Mark Webber及其团队压回他们的位置上。但传闻非但没有平息，反而愈演愈烈——部分原因是某些人喜欢向社交媒体的回音室里投放消息、以期抬高自己声望的恼人习惯。于是迈凯伦开始踩刹车。
另外，有消息传出——当然不是通过那些惯常的荷兰媒体渠道——‘Team Max’真正想要的，除了保证赛车性能会提升之外，还包括车队本身的股权。这可是一个很高的要求——事实上，这正是让前车队领队Christian Horner的雄心撞得粉碎的那块礁石。
因此，才需要让这些传闻一直延续到夏休期，远超它们本应自然偃旗息鼓的时间。所以现在的问题是：Max得到他想要的了吗？
进一步的问题：这对马克斯·维斯塔潘的业余赛车活动是帮助还是阻碍？
我同意Fil的观点，维斯塔潘决定留在红牛本身并不令人意外，但续约对双方来说都是一个明确的表态。虽然小红牛22至今还没有赢得过比赛，但它在这一年里有了显著进步，红牛似乎对'26年规则的要求有了更好的把握。也许维斯塔潘被进步的速度所鼓舞。也许Mekies向他提出了一个长期规划。也许他的薪水后面又多加了几个零……
我的同事们已经很好地谈到了维斯塔潘这份续约在F1方面的意义。所以，我的问题是：这会如何影响这位荷兰车手在跑车赛和耐力赛领域的业余探索——新合同是否提供了更多余地，以及红牛作为一个品牌可能提供的进一步支持？
尽管NLS和纽博格林24小时耐力赛的长期车迷们会说这些赛事一直以来都非常好看、值得追随，但维斯塔潘的到来对纽博格林GT赛场的影响是不可估量的。他本人在GT3比赛中的表现，看起来完全摆脱了F1的压力束缚，并享受着投身于一个陌生领域的过程。而且他在这方面也确实非常、非常擅长，这大概也有帮助……
他在今年纽博格林24小时耐力赛上的表现令人惊叹，以至于数百万人都为他可能在大型耐力赛事中的进一步亮相而兴奋——也许是勒芒？戴通纳？巴瑟斯特？还是英国割草机赛车12小时赛？只要让他坐进一辆赛车（或者割草机），车迷们就会成群结队地前来观看他开拓新的领域。
但由于（姑且这么说）重新将重心放在F1上，维斯塔潘还有余力去探索那些比赛吗？我当然希望如此，但由于勒芒似乎执意与F1赛事时间冲突，想在拉萨尔特看到他像尼科·霍肯伯格那样登场，感觉不太可能。不过理论上仍有一扇敞开的大门：福特的LMDh赛车将于明年进入世界耐力锦标赛，而红牛与福特的关系可能成为维斯塔潘在其他类别赛事中实现愿望的通道。
我们只能希望新合同能带给这位四届世界冠军更多的自由，让他能出现在以前未曾涉足的领域。每当他尝试新的东西时，都会带来两个效果：其一，加深我们对这位赛车界最伟大天才之一的欣赏；其二，彰显他作为多学科全才的地位，宛如吉姆·克拉克、格拉汉姆·希尔等前辈……
detailEn: What does Max Verstappen's new contract say about Red Bull and his F1 future? Our writers have their say
A show of faith in Laurent Mekies or his only real option – our writers share their verdict on the Dutchman's F1 contract renewal
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal
The wild rumours of a shock switch to Mercedes or McLaren were silenced this morning when Max Verstappen confirmed a new deal to stay with Red Bull for a further three Formula 1 seasons.

The Dutchman announced a new contract with Red Bull that runs until the end of F1’s current era in 2030, putting an end to any speculation swirling about his trust in the team and his love for F1... for now.
But what does the new deal mean for Verstappen, Red Bull and Formula 1? Our writers share their verdict on the signing.

Last year, incoming team principal Laurent Mekies inherited a tricky position at Red Bull, fighting against the narrative of a crumbling empire that key figures were gradually running away from – including the likes of design legend Adrian Newey, sporting director Jonathan Wheatley and strategy chief Will Courtenay.

Red Bull's late 2025 turnaround, when Verstappen came remarkably close to snatching the world championship away from the McLaren drivers, allayed some of those fears. But Verstappen's close ally Gianpiero Lambiase signing a deal to move to McLaren by 2028 did little to dispel the notion that, if not a sinking ship, Red Bull's vessel had at least taken on a copious amount of water.

The start to the 2026 season hasn't gone particularly well either, with Red Bull behind on car development as it sits fourth in the championship, while being outmanoeuvred in F1's political power unit games.

But tying down the team's four-time world championship for another two years is a huge string to Mekies' bow. Having the Dutchman on board will be instrumental to Red Bull's long-term ambitions, and a sign that there is a modicum of faith in Mekies' plans to evolve the team's technical set-up.

News of Verstappen staying put isn't a big surprise, but the two-year extension is, at least to some extent. The details of the new contract are yet to emerge, but the most logical outcome is that Verstappen will be richly remunerated for his extended commitment, while Red Bull will likely have bought that commitment with performance clauses that are more team-friendly than the previous arrangement, which turned Verstappen's future into a circus act every summer.
Proof that McLaren rumours were a negotiating tactic

Formula 1’s chattering classes spent the summer falling over each other on social media claiming exclusive insider knowledge of Verstappen’s imminent move to McLaren. But it was patently obvious to those really in the know that this was an elaborate bluff.

The reason for this is that George Russell and Lewis Hamilton had already met performance clauses in their existing ‘two plus one’ contracts enabling Mercedes and Ferrari to trigger the ‘plus one’ elements, taking them through to the end of 2027. Since these were simply the mechanics of existing contracts, rather than new ones or bolt-on extensions, they passed without any public announcements.

Given Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli were also secure, that closed off the most likely moves Max would make. So, what could his management team do to secure the most advantageous terms from Red Bull.

Ever since RBR’s precipitous fall from its previously dominant position in early 2024, Verstappen and his management have pursued a “treat ‘em mean, keep ‘em keen” strategy, regularly putting it out there via client scribblers in the Dutch media that Verstappen’s contract features performance clauses very much in his favour that could allow him to leave ahead of term.

But departing also requires a plausible destination. With the routes to Mercedes and Ferrari closed off, McLaren had to serve as the negotiating lever – and so rumours of the Dutchman swapping places with Oscar Piastri were conjured into existence.

At first, McLaren affected a position of quietly amused complicity, since its relations with Piastri’s management grew fractious last season, so entertaining these rumours served to put Mark Webber and his team back in their box. But instead of going away, the rumours intensified – partly as a result of the irksome habit of some individuals to feed the social media echo chamber in the hope of boosting their own profiles. Hence McLaren began to apply the brakes.

Separately, word got around – not via the usual Dutch outlets, of course – that what ‘Team Max’ was really looking for, beyond assurances that car performance would improve, was equity in the team itself. That’s a big ask – indeed, it’s the rock upon which former team principal Christian Horner’s ambition crashed.
Hence the need to keep the rumours going into the summer break, long after they would have organically spluttered out. So, the question now is: did Max get what he wanted?
Further questions: does it help or hinder Max Verstappen's extra-curricular racing?

I agree with Fil's sentiment that Verstappen's decision to stay with Red Bull isn't surprising in itself, but an extension is very much a statement from both sides. Although the RB22 is yet to win a race, it has improved significantly through the year and Red Bull appears to be getting more of a handle on the demands of the '26 regs. Perhaps Verstappen was enthused by the rate of progress. Perhaps Mekies approached him with a long-term game plan. Perhaps a few extra zeroes were added to his salary...

My colleagues have perfectly addressed the F1 side of Verstappen's extended deal. So, my question is this: how does this affect the Dutchman's extra-curricular exploration in sportscars and endurance racing - does the new deal offer more leeway, and potentially further support from Red Bull as a brand?

As much as long-time followers of the NLS and the Nurburgring 24 Hours will state that these series have always been great to watch and follow, the impact of Verstappen's arrival across the Nurburgring GT scene is immeasurable. The man himself has looked unshackled from the demands of F1 in his GT3 outings, and has enjoyed throwing himself into an unfamiliar discipline. It probably helps that he's also really, really good at it...

His performance at this year's Nurburgring 24 Hours was dazzling, to the point where millions were excited about potential further appearances in the big enduro events - Le Mans, perhaps? Daytona? Bathurst? The British Lawnmower Racing 12 Hours? Put him a car (or a mower) and fans will turn up in their droves to watch him explore a new frontier.

But with a, let's say, renewed focus on F1, does Verstappen still have the leeway to explore those races? I certainly would hope so but, with Le Mans seemingly committed to clashing with F1 events, the notion of seeing a Nico Hulkenberg-esque turn at La Sarthe feels a touch unlikely. There is a theoretical open door, given Ford's LMDh car is due to enter the World Endurance Championship next year, and the Red Bull-Ford relationship could be a gateway towards Verstappen's wish-fulfilment motives in other categories.

We can but hope the new deal gives the four-time champion a bit more freedom to crop up in previously uncharted waters. Every time he tries his hand at something new, it does two things: one, adds to our appreciation for one of racing's greatest talents, and two, underlines his status as a multi-discipline throwback, a la Jim Clark, Graham Hill, et al...

detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯分享了约舒亚·杜尔肯森与巴拉圭总统之间的情感通话
约舒亚·杜尔肯森在成为该国首位测试现代一级方程式赛车的车手后，收到了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳的电话
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克莱利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯分享了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳给发展车手约舒亚·杜尔肯森打电话祝贺他首次参加一级方程式测试的时刻
“一个非常特别的电话。巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳确保祝贺乔什第一次参加F1赛事。这对国家来说是一个自豪的时刻，”梅赛德斯在视频通话的片段旁边发布了这条消息。
“这个片段来自一部幕后视频，名为《梅赛德斯内部：约书亚·杜尔肯森的第一次F1测试，巴拉圭，我们做到了！》，这是Brackley团队在本周早些时候发布的。
“这位22岁的年轻人两天前在波尔蒂马奥驾驶梅赛德斯W16赛车，这辆赛车在2025年锦标赛中由乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利驾驶。
“这对杜尔肯森来说是一个重要的时刻，这也是第一位驾驶现代F1赛车的巴拉圭车手。‘传奇！这太棒了，伙计，’总统佩纳在电话中对杜尔肯森说。‘约书亚，我真的很兴奋。这是你的梦想，也是我的梦想，是数百万巴拉圭人的梦想，我们都为你的成就感到自豪。我们梦想中的那个巨大的巴拉圭，就是你。’
Durksen在视频中补充道：“从一个许多人认为我们是一个小国家，也许我们无法做很多事情的国家，到达到赛车运动的顶峰，驾驶F1赛车……我认为这是一个明确的信息，特别是对我的同胞来说，我们被允许做梦，我们可以做大梦，我们可以实现这些梦想。”
我认为在驾驶之后，我甚至更加热爱这项运动，而且这肯定是我想要长期从事的事情。
粉丝们分享了他们对巴拉圭车手的激动之情。
一个粉丝评论道：“对整个巴拉圭来说是多么自豪的事情！加油，约书亚，如果你能做到的话！！！！”另一个粉丝补充说：“约书亚太棒了，我希望他们能尽快给他一个F1的座位。”
detailEn: Mercedes shares emotional call between Joshua Durksen and Paraguay president
Joshua Durksen received a call from Paraguayan president Santiago Peña after becoming the first driver from his country to test a modern F1 car
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes has shared the moment Paraguay's president, Santiago Pena, phoned development driver Joshua Durksen to congratulate him on his first Formula 1 test.
"A very special call. Santiago Pena, president of Paraguay, made sure to congratulate Josh on his first F1 run. A proud moment for the country," Mercedes posted alongside footage of the video call.
The clip comes from a behind-the-scenes video, Inside Mercedes: Joshua Durksen's First F1 Test, Paraguay, We Did It!, that was released by the Brackley outfit earlier this week.
The 22-year-old spent two days at Portimao at the wheel of the Mercedes W16, which was raced by George Russell and Kimi Antonelli in the 2025 championship.

Not only was it a big moment for Durksen, but it was also the first time a driver from Paraguay had driven a modern F1 car. "Legend! That's huge, man," president Pena told Durksen on the call. "Joshua, I'm really excited. This is your dream, it's my dream, it's the dream of millions of Paraguayans who truly are proud of everything you're accomplishing. That giant Paraguay we all dream about, it's you."

Durksen added in the video: "To come from a country that many people think we're a small country, and that maybe we cannot do a lot of stuff, to reaching the top of motorsport and driving a Formula 1 car... I think it's a clear message, especially to my people, that we are allowed to dream, that we can dream big and that we can accomplish these dreams.
"I think after driving, I'm even more in love with this sport, and for sure this is something I want to do for the very long term."
Fans shared their excitement for the Paraguayan driver.
"What pride for all of Paraguay! Let's go, Joshua, if you can!!!!" one fan commented, while another added: "Joshua is so great, I want them to give him a seat in F1 soon."

relatedItems.originalTitle: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
relatedItems.summaryEn: Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta revealed that the team evaluated the rotating "Macarena" rear wing concept more than a year ago but ultimately decided against it.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释为何一年多前放弃马卡雷纳尾翼
梅赛德斯副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔透露，车队一年多前就评估过旋转式尾翼概念
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯F1车队早在竞争对手将其投入赛道使用之前，就研究过自建马卡雷纳尾翼。但据副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔表示，车队最终决定不采用。
这种旋转翼——当赛车切换至直线模式时，其主翼片会翻转——在当前这一规则时代已成为非常显眼的创新。法拉利最先采用这一想法，并被称为“玛卡arena翼”，红牛也在迈阿密带来了自己的版本。迈凯伦——我们已看到其在测试自己的版本——表示将在未来某个时候让其一战。
梅赛德斯是四大车队中唯一尚未对此类设计表现出兴趣的车队。如今，雷斯塔在车队自己的最新一期《银箭电台秀》节目中解释了原因。
“我大概要说一些我们之前没有分享过的事情：大约一年多以前，我们的绘图板上就有这种翼了，”雷斯塔说。“我们一直在相当详细地评估这个概念，它显然在降低阻力方面带来了好处，但在你操作开缝模式（Open SM）的每一节练习与排位中，也会带来下压力的减少。
“这是我们评估过的东西。这是我们从未觉得在平衡上是最佳整体折衷方案的东西，可以说，所以值得在研发以及制造部件等方面进行投入。但这并不意味着同样的结论永远有效，我们可能会在今后重新审视我们的观点和立场。
“所以我们当然保持谦逊，逐一检查现有的所有方案，评估是否有任何对我们有价值、值得采纳的东西，并让这个迭代过程持续下去。”
梅赛德斯到目前为止在没有该尾翼的情况下依然应对自如。车队以578分领跑车队积分榜，领先法拉利134分；进入美国大奖赛比赛周时，安东内利领先队友拉塞尔102分。
不过，重点是在此前于新加坡站将升级分配给两位车手之后，把新升级带到两辆车上。安东内利使用了新升级，而拉塞尔测试了旧版本。车队领队托托·沃尔夫此后确认，新部件将在美国站出现在两辆车上。
detailEn: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta reveals the team evaluated the rotating rear wing concept more than a year ago
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes Formula 1 team looked at building its own Macarena rear wing long before it was seen running on a circuit by a rival outfit. But according to deputy technical director Simone Resta, it decided against it.

The rotating wing, whose main flap turns over when a car switches into straight-line mode, has become a very visible innovation so far in this current era of regulation. Ferrari was first to run the idea with it being coined the Macarena wing, and Red Bull brought its own version to Miami. McLaren, who we have seen testing its own, has said it will race one at some point in the future.
Mercedes is the only one of the top four teams yet to show an interest in such a design. Now, Resta has explained why on the latest episode of the team's own Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show.

"I am probably going to say something we have not shared before: we had this kind of wing on our drawing board a bit more than a year ago," Resta said. "We've been evaluating this concept quite in detail and it's clearly offering a benefit in drag reduction, but it's also coming with a reduction of downforce in every session you operate the Open SM.

"And it's something that we evaluated it. It's something that we never felt in balance to be the best overall compromise, let's say, so worth, let's say, investing in terms of development and also making components, etc. But it doesn't mean that the same conclusion is valid forever and we might revisit our view and our position going forward.
"So we are, of course, humble, checking every solution that is out there, evaluate if there's anything interesting for us to pick up and keep this iterative process going forward."

Mercedes has managed without the wing so far. The team leads the constructors' championship on 578 points, 134 clear of Ferrari, and Kimi Antonelli is 102 points ahead of team-mate George Russell as they go into the race week of the United States Grand Prix.

The focus is, however, on bringing the new upgrade to both cars after it was previously split between the drivers in Singapore. Antonelli used the new upgrade while Russell tested the older version. Team principal Toto Wolff has since confirmed the new components will be seen on both cars at the American race.
